topic: Build your first AI app this weekend

cover.concept: Cinematic night photo: a student's desk by a window with city lights, lit by an open laptop's glow, a mug and a notebook beside it.
cover.lineDraft: Your first AI app, live by Sunday night.

slides.label: Saturday, 10 AM
slides.idea: Pick one small problem from your own college life

slides.label: Saturday, 2 PM
slides.idea: Make one call to an LLM API and see it answer (verify free-tier limits on the day)

slides.label: Saturday, 7 PM
slides.idea: Add a simple screen: one input, one answer

slides.label: Sunday, 11 AM
slides.idea: Test where it fails: empty input, very long text, wrong language, made-up answers

slides.label: Sunday, 4 PM
slides.idea: Put it online and get a live link

slides.label: Sunday, 8 PM
slides.idea: Write the README: what it does and where the model fails
friend who says "I'll start AI next semester"

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Cinematic night photograph, magazine-ad quality, subtle film grain. A student's wooden desk by a window with distant city lights, lit only by an open laptop's cool glow and a small warm desk lamp; a ceramic mug, a closed notebook and a pen beside the laptop; a pair of hands rests near the keyboard. The desk sits in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is dark, calm window and wall. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
